about.subtitle: WHO IS DINO PÉO?
about.title: A Bit About Me
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Trần Duy Phát, a dedicated developer based in Vietnam. I'm passionate about deciphering challenging problems and creating exceptional digital experiences that live on the web.

As I've grown as a developer, I've focused on mastering modern front-end technologies. I've contributed to various projects, collaborating with teams to build robust, maintainable applications with a focus on clean, understandable code.

Through my academic journey and self-study, I've gained a solid understanding of web development concepts. I dedicate significant time to applying these principles to real-world scenarios, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the browser.
When I'm not building, learning, or exploring new UI trends, you can catch me watching football matches or seeking inspiration for my next creative project.

projects.subtitle: MY PROJECTS
projects.title: Some Things I Built
projects.description: I like to stay busy and always have a project in the works. Take a look at some of the applications I've have built

1.title: Personal Portfolio
1.description: A high-performance personal portfolio built with React 19, TypeScript, and Framer Motion, drawing its visual language from a technical 'System UI' aesthetic with sharp edges and signature glow effects. Every section is tuned for fast load times and smooth transitions, with a fully responsive layout across all screen sizes. Full Vietnamese-English localization is built in from the ground up using i18next, letting visitors switch languages instantly without a page reload.

2.title: E-commerce Website
2.description: A modern e-commerce platform built with React and Firebase, letting users browse products, manage their cart, and track order status in real time. Product and user data sync instantly through Firestore, paired with secure account authentication via Firebase Authentication. The interface is built with Tailwind CSS and Zustand for cart state management, delivering a smooth shopping experience across devices.

3.title: Restaurant Website
3.description: An elegant restaurant website that presents the menu in a visually engaging way and lets guests place orders directly from the browser. The design leans on refined visuals that showcase the dishes and dining atmosphere to draw customers in. Built with React and Vite, with Firebase powering the menu data, the site loads fast and stays easy to update.

4.title: Weather Forecast
4.description: A comprehensive weather forecast application delivering real-time atmospheric details — temperature, humidity, wind speed, and UV index — for multiple locations at once. The interface follows a modern HUD-style design, visualizing data through charts and lively weather icons. Built with React, TypeScript, and Zustand for efficient state management, and integrated with an external weather API for accurate, up-to-date data.

5.title: DinoMovie - Movie Discovery Platform
5.description: A movie discovery platform powered by the TMDB API, letting users search and browse detailed information and ratings for thousands of films. Advanced filters by genre, release year, and rating help users quickly find content that matches their taste. The entire interface follows a polished Dark UI aesthetic, built with React and Tailwind CSS for optimized rendering performance.

6.title: DinoStore - Online Store
6.description: A fast online store built with React and Vite, focused on streamlining cart logic and checkout flow for a seamless shopping experience. Cart state persists locally, so users never lose their selections on a page reload. The minimal interface keeps the focus on product visuals and quick actions, making it well suited for small to mid-sized shops.

7.title: DinoBot - Discord Management Bot
7.description: A versatile Discord bot that automates server management — from content moderation and role assignment to mini-games that boost community engagement. Written in Node.js with discord.js, it uses a modular command structure that keeps maintenance and future feature additions straightforward. The project also ships with a companion website where users can check the bot's status and browse its command list.

8.title: ShopFSTYLE - Fashion Commerce System
8.description: A full-featured fashion e-commerce system built specifically for the FSTYLE shop, covering the entire operational flow from product management and category organization to inventory tracking and order processing. It includes a dedicated admin area for the shop owner to update products and monitor revenue. Built with PHP and MySQL on the backend, paired with Tailwind CSS on the frontend, to run a real, working storefront.

9.title: Pokédex Mobile
9.description: A mobile app for exploring the Pokémon world via the PokéAPI, letting users look up base stats, elemental types, evolution chains, and detailed artwork for each Pokémon. It supports fast search and type-based filtering for an intuitive discovery experience. Built with React Native, Expo, and TypeScript, it runs smoothly and consistently on both iOS and Android.

10.title: LinkSnap - URL & Bio Page
10.description: An advanced link management platform that combines a URL shortener with a customizable Bio Page builder, in the spirit of tools like Linktree or Bitly. Users can track real-time click analytics, view engagement charts, and generate custom QR codes for each link. The platform supports one-click Google OAuth login and is built with Laravel and MySQL on the backend for stable performance and security.
